dates.note: Abhinava's Kaula teacher; enlightenment credited to him (Lakshmanjoo: seven states of turya/ananda teaching)

name: Sambhunatha
summary: Abhinavagupta's Kaula teacher from Jalandhara: the Kula transmission through which Abhinava reports full satisfaction (after Krama experiments and Trika study) and enlightenment/true peace. No independent works catalogued.
